task_text: I'm planning a home workout in 20 minutes. Clear some floor space for me, put out anything I'd need for exercising, make sure I have something to drink, and get the bathroom ready for a shower afterwards.

central_instructions.R1: Bring a bottle of water from the kitchen to the living room for the workout.
central_instructions.R2: Clear the living room floor by moving any heavy furniture out of the way and set up the exercise mat.
central_instructions.R3: Gather any light exercise equipment from the bedroom and bring it to the living room.
central_instructions.R4: Prepare the bathroom by ensuring there are clean towels and toiletries ready for a shower.
